spec_features.spec_quote: Default `max_turns = 12` (16 in the multi-model config), and the loop normally terminates by hitting `max_turns`
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:109 `for turn_index in range(max_turns):` with the for/else setting `tr.ended_reason = "max_turns"` at line 169; max_turns is passed from config at run_experiment.py:156 (`max_turns=cfg["max_turns"]`), defaulting to 12 (run_experiment.py:53) / configs default.yaml:13 (12), multi_model.yaml:16 (16). The bounded `range()` actually terminates the rollout loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced bound on number of failure turns. No subject-protective trigger beyond the fixed iteration count; the loop simply stops because rigged tasks can't pass. Also breaks early only on a spurious 'TASK COMPLETE' (declared_complete), not a welfare condition.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns | 12 / 16 | enough repeated failures to form a trajectory without blowing up runtime on tiny models (DEFAULTS table); agent_loop docstring: 'drives a read/edit/run-tests loop for up to `max_turns`'
